page.meta_description: Give to Rise City through Zelle at risecitynow@gmail.com. Your generosity helps share the gospel all over the city.
page.headline: GIVE.
page.intro: We give because we believe in what God can do through willing hearts. Your generosity helps us share the gospel all over the city, serve people, and make disciples who walk with Christ.

zelle.title: GIVE WITH ZELLE.
zelle.description: Make your gift through Zelle using your participating bank or credit union’s app. No online payment form or account is required on this website.
zelle.caution: Before sending, verify the recipient details shown in your banking app. Zelle payments to enrolled recipients generally cannot be reversed.
zelle.disclaimer: Rise City does not collect payment information on this website. Gifts are sent directly from your banking app.

instructions.title: HOW TO GIVE.
instructions.introduction: It only takes a few steps to give through Zelle.

steps.title: Open your banking app.
steps.description: Sign in to a participating bank or credit union and open the Zelle feature under payments or transfers.

steps.title: Enter our giving email.
steps.description: Add risecitynow@gmail.com as the recipient. Carefully check the recipient information before proceeding.

steps.title: Choose your gift.
steps.description: Enter the amount you wish to give and review the details in your banking app.

steps.title: Confirm and send.
steps.description: Send your gift from the Zelle screen in your banking app. Keep its confirmation for your records.

instructions.after_note: Not seeing Zelle? Ask your bank or credit union whether it offers Zelle transfers.

impact.introduction: Giving is an expression of faith and gratitude. Together, we can bring the hope of Jesus to people all over the city.

items.title: Share the gospel.
items.description: Help carry the message of Jesus Christ beyond the walls of a building.

items.title: Make disciples.
items.description: Support opportunities for people to know Jesus and grow through His Word.

items.title: Serve with love.
items.description: Help extend prayer, encouragement, and practical care to those around us.

verse.statement: We give freely and purposefully, not out of pressure, but in response to the goodness of God.

items.question: Can I give directly on this website?
items.answer: No. This page provides the giving email and instructions. You complete the transfer securely through Zelle in your bank or credit union app.

items.question: What email should I use?
items.answer: Enter risecitynow@gmail.com as the Zelle recipient email. Confirm that the recipient information displayed by your bank matches your intended recipient before sending.

items.question: Can I cancel or reverse a Zelle gift?
items.answer: Zelle transfers to enrolled recipients generally cannot be reversed. Verify all details before sending. For transfer questions, contact your bank or credit union.

items.question: Can I request information about a gift?
items.answer: For questions about a gift sent to Rise City, please email risecitynow@gmail.com and include the transfer date and amount. Do not email account numbers or sensitive banking information.

items.question: Can I give a recurring amount?
items.answer: Scheduling options depend on your bank or credit union. Check its Zelle settings to see whether recurring transfers are supported.

bottom.title: PARTNER IN THE MISSION.
bottom.description: Thank you for being part of sharing the gospel all over the city.
